column1: # THE FIXTURE CONTRACT.  The fixture DOMAIN is derived from the LIVE
# enum definitions, not from any historical count.
# THE ENUM VALUES, RESOLVED BY COMPILING THE LIVE src/ast.h
#   COMMAND=cc -I src -I src/asm -o enumprobe enumprobe.c   # includes src/ast.h
#   i.e. SKIP exactly when the statement is a DECL whose declvar is
#   The decision is a total function of TWO bounded I64 values.
#   The fixture must therefore cover the PARTITION of the domain
#   that the decision distinguishes, plus the invalid and
#   out-of-enum regions, plus the SHORT-CIRCUIT region.
#   P1 stmt_kind == AST_DECL(263) AND declvar_kind == AST_GVAR(256)
#   P2 stmt_kind == AST_DECL(263) AND declvar_kind != AST_GVAR
#   P3 stmt_kind != AST_DECL AND declvar_kind == AST_GVAR(256)
#      -> APPEND (the declvar value is NOT consulted)
#   P4 stmt_kind != AST_DECL AND declvar_kind != AST_GVAR
#   P5 declvar_kind is an UNREACHABLE value (the C side never
#      evaluates it when stmt_kind != AST_DECL): the component
#      MUST NOT consult it, and the result MUST be APPEND.
#   P6 stmt_kind is an out-of-enum value: the component MUST NOT
#      range-check it, and the result MUST be APPEND.
#   P7 negative I64 values for both inputs: MUST be APPEND.
#   P8 the extreme I64 values: MUST be APPEND.
# THE FIXTURE MUST INCLUDE, AT MINIMUM
#   - every AstKind value in the live src/ast.h enum, for
#     stmt_kind, paired with AST_GVAR and with AST_LVAR
#   - the AST_DECL x AST_GVAR pair itself
#   - the out-of-enum and extreme values above.
# NO COUNT IS ASSERTED HERE.  The fixture producer enumerates the
# live enum and the contract only specifies the PARTITION.
